title: [review] adaptation_vectors.rs: Default rule_id 0 masks incomplete vecto
description: unwrap_or(0) for expect_rule_id defaults to 0 (RULE_LINK_LOCAL_COAP), which is a valid rule. If a test vector is misconfigured with missing expect_rule_id but the actual rejected rule happens to be 0, the test passes incorrectly. Consider using expect() or logging when defaulting.
